stem: Which statement correctly completes this time line?

options.label: A
options.text: The Allied powers divide Germany and Berlin into four sectors.

options.label: B
options.text: German citizens vote to reunite East and West Germany.

options.label: C
options.text: The United States and Great Britain airlift supplies to West Berlin.

options.label: D
options.text: The United Nations sends troops into Eastern Europe.
